text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
choice_data_list: What on earth is going on here...?
What is even going on right now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Shh, Trainer. Please be quiet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have learned. The more one reacts to 
Gold Ship-san, the more conceited she 
becomes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Then what if I don't react?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Gold Ship the kind of Umamusume 
who'll pull something crazy even without 
any reaction from me...? When I shared 
this concern with Mejiro McQueen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...No, there is no need to worry. After 
all, this is a 'match' against me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mee-n min min min min!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Aah, it's a Golshi Seminar!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I've intercepted a suspicious 
transmission! An emergency message from 
Planet Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What... all-you-can-eat melon parfaits!? 
With an exclusive photo of Mac-chan's Mont 
Blanc!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...You've got to be kidding me, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen's declaration was the real 
deal. She wasn't fazed in the slightest by 
Gold Ship's antics—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't believe this! This must be 
another one of Gold Ship-san's schemes. To 
think she would shed such meek tears...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Please wait a moment! Where did all 
your usual, downright obnoxious energy 
go!?
choice_data_list:
...Why don't you pay them some attention 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Please wait a moment! Where did all 
your usual, downright obnoxious energy 
go!?
choice_data_list:
...Why don't you pay them some attention 
soon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Na-hahaha! That's exactly right, McQueen!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You reacted, so you lose! Now sit tight 
and let me mess with you today!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now then, even if you call for help up on 
this roof, there's only the two of you, ya 
know? So today—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ? Gold Ship-san?
choice_data_list:
Are you not sure how to interact with 
her...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way in hell! It's all about 
passion! Passion!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Then please make your move quickly. We 
have training scheduled as well, you see."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I got it, I got it!! I'll whip up a UFO 
for ya in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-Wha, a UFO!? Can they really be summoned 
so casually!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Gold Ship-san, you liar. I can't 
believe I ended up tied down until this 
hour.
choice_data_list:
Nothing good ever comes from getting 
involved with this...

Nothing good ever comes from getting 
involved with them, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will not be fooled next time. No 
matter what happens, I shall endure it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...It seems my worrying was completely 
unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breathing a sigh of relief, Mejiro McQueen 
still makes that firm vow to herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was just three days later that she was 
tricked by Gold Ship yet again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
!! ...You are right. Perhaps I was being 
overly stubborn myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Gold Ship-san. I had no 
intention of hurting you. May I come 
closer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ? Am I to take that nod as an affirmative?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Pet me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Sometimes you act just like a child. 
Even with such a large frame. ...Your hair 
is so silky-smooth, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...How do you feel? Has your mood cleared 
up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...More.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, McQueen! Next, let's go pet 100 
rhinoceros beetles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wh...?! Absolutely not! Jeez! Just when I 
thought you were back on your feet, you 
pull this immediately—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen was being dragged along by 
Gold Ship, who was back in full swing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet the corners of her mouth softened ever 
so slightly, as if in relief.
